verdict.rationale: Cognee is documented as open source and runnable fully locally — via pip/embedded Python calls, a local Docker container, and a local UI/CLI with 'no account required' and 'free, forever' self-hosting (cognee-docs-7, cognee-docs-10, cognee-docs-14, cognee-docs-26, cognee-docs-33). This covers in-process/self-hosted deployment without cloud dependency for the core engine, storage, and UI. missing for 10: explicit evidence of configuring/using local LLMs or embedding models (e.g. Ollama) so inference itself has no cloud dependency, and independent hands-on confirmation of a fully offline run.
